theme_and_positioning.concept: Detective-noir crossed with the warmth of a Bollywood record sleeve.
theme_and_positioning.vibe: Cinematic, moody, and premium. Every round is a 'case', reveals are 'verdicts', history is a 'case file'.
theme_and_positioning.core_insight: The satisfying moment is recognizing a song from almost nothing. Guessing in one second is the flex.
theme_and_positioning.target_audience: Indian Gen Z and young millennials (18-28), secondary nostalgia listeners (28-45).

discipline_rules: GOLD DISCIPLINE: Gold appears ONLY on the primary action button, the revealed portion of the waveform, and the active nav item.
The app reads as near-monochrome with gold as a scarce, earned accent.
Use verdict teal (#3E9E93) ONLY for solved states.

visual_enhancers.lighting: Use soft radial gradients (using gold_glow #FFD07A at 10-20% opacity) behind the hero waveform like a desk lamp lighting evidence.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (grain) on the base background to emulate old record sleeves and noir film.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard, sharp drop shadows (neo-brutalist but dark mode) or extremely soft cinematic ambient glows. Avoid default Tailwind soft shadows.

waveform_hero.description: The signature element. Full width, tall.
waveform_hero.playhead: Bright gold or white vertical line at the boundary.
waveform_hero.background: Radial gold glow (#FFD07A) sitting behind it.

mcq_options.default: Surface background (#1A1719), hairline border (#3A3238), primary text.

buttons.primary: Solid primary gold (#F2A93B), dark text (inverse). Used sparingly.
buttons.secondary: Elevated surface (#241F22) with hairline border (#3A3238), primary text (#F7F1E6).
buttons.radius: Slightly rounded, e.g., rounded-md or rounded-none for a harsher noir look.

verdict_stamps.style: Large, angled, uppercase, using display font with tight letter spacing. 'SOLVED' in teal, 'UNSOLVED' in copper.

emoji_share_grid.format: Audio blocks showing attempts. 🟩 for teal/correct, 🟥 for copper/wrong, ⬛ for unplayed/locked.

cards.style: Surface (#1A1719) with hairline border (#3A3238). No default soft shadows.

headers.rules: Must have a solid or highly blurred background (bg-[#0E0D0F]/90 backdrop-blur-xl). NEVER use purely transparent backgrounds if content scrolls underneath.

layouts.mobile_first: Design primarily for mobile devices (portrait). Constrain max-width on desktop to sm (max-w-md or max-w-lg) to retain the app feel.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Tailwind scale: p-4 for list items, p-6 to p-8 for layout boundaries.
layouts.grids: Use 1-column stacks for main flow. Use tight 2-column or 3-column dense grids for stats.

motion.waveform: Smooth horizontal fill animation for the playhead and revealed portion.
motion.verdict: Stamp effect (scale down, quick opacity fade in, slight rotation).
motion.hover_states: Subtle brightness increase or border color shift. NEVER jumpy.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary text (#F7F1E6) on base (#0E0D0F) meets WCAG AAA. Muted text (#9A9188) must meet AA.
accessibility.screen_readers: Waveform must have aria-label describing the track progress. Use aria-live for the timer/score updates.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do not use standard Shadcn/Tailwind generic colors (e.g., slate, blue). You MUST use the exact hex codes provided in this JSON.
CRITICAL: Adhere to the GOLD DISCIPLINE. Only the primary button, waveform revealed state, and active nav get the gold color.
CRITICAL: All generated code should be in .js/.jsx, NOT .tsx (unless typescript is explicitly set up, but the prompt dictates .js).
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based format (e.g., data-testid='submit-guess-button', data-testid='mcq-option').
DO NOT use generic centered app layouts. Left-align text for readability, center only high-impact hero elements like the waveform or verdict stamp.
For the audio player, do not call external APIs at runtime. It should expect a pre-stored iTunes preview URL.
Use Lucide-react for icons, but force them to inherit text-primary or text-muted. Icons are NEVER gold.
Sonner is recommended for toasts, customized to match the dark noir theme.

universal_guidelines.aesthetic: Avoid generic 'AI slop'. Make it look like a curated museum piece or a moody Spotify wrapped.
universal_guidelines.depth: Create depth via color separation (base vs surface vs elevated) and hairlines, rather than massive blurry drop shadows.
universal_guidelines.components_reuse: Use src/components/ui for base components (buttons, dialogs) but heavily customize their Tailwind classes to match this theme.
